gates.name: License audit
gates.notes: Final license report is not embedded in this repository evidence bundle.

gates.name: Secret scan

gates.name: SBOM

gates.name: Signature status

security_exceptions.rationale: The repository evidence bundle documents v0.1 release readiness but does not produce final distribution artifacts.
security_exceptions.mitigation: No SBOM claim is made for v0.1 repository evidence; release CI must generate and attach an SBOM before a distributable release is published.
security_exceptions.follow_up: Generate SBOM from the release candidate build in release CI.

security_exceptions.rationale: Cryptographic artifact signing is not implemented by this repository evidence bundle.
security_exceptions.mitigation: The bundle publishes checksums only and explicitly avoids making any signature claim.
security_exceptions.follow_up: Add artifact signing to the release pipeline before publishing signed binary artifacts.

security_exceptions.rationale: The repository evidence bundle cannot embed final CI advisory, license, and secret-scan reports before the release candidate workflow completes.
security_exceptions.mitigation: Security-report gates are marked as documented limitations and must be replaced or supplemented by final CI-produced reports at release cutover.
security_exceptions.follow_up: Attach final advisory, license, and secret-scan outputs from release CI.
